header.title: Bar Chart
header.subtitle: Single-series bar chart built on Recharts BarChart. Renders rounded bars with a highlighted cursor on hover. Shares the same formatter and yLabel API as AreaChart.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: Same Recharts primitives as AreaChart but without the gradient. The Bar element renders rounded rectangles capped at maxBarSize to avoid overly wide bars on sparse datasets.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Pass data, xKey, and yKey. The color defaults to var(--accent). Hover a bar to see the tooltip.

formatters.title: With formatters
formatters.description: Same formatter API as AreaChart — formatY for Y-axis ticks, formatTooltip for the tooltip value.

yLabel.title: With yLabel
yLabel.description: Pass yLabel to replace the raw yKey string in the tooltip label. Use a localised string from t() at the call site.

colors.title: Custom colors
colors.description: Pass any CSS color to the color prop. Use system tokens for theme compatibility.

loading.title: Loading and error states
loading.description: See the canonical loading and error pattern documented on the Area Chart page.

props.title: Props
props.description: All props except data, xKey, and yKey are optional.

anatomy.responsiveContainer: Responsive wrapper — fills parent width, uses the height prop
anatomy.barChart: Recharts BarChart root — receives data array and margin config
anatomy.cartesianGrid: Horizontal grid lines — uses chartGridProps from @lib/charts
anatomy.xAxis: Bottom axis — renders tick labels from xKey; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.yAxis: Left axis — renders tick labels via formatY; uses chartAxisProps
anatomy.tooltip: Hover overlay — cursor highlights the bar column; styled via chartTooltipStyle
anatomy.bar: Bar element — rounded top corners (radius 4px), capped at maxBarSize 32px

props.data: Array of data objects. Each object must contain the xKey and yKey fields.
props.xKey: Key of the field used for X-axis labels.
props.yKey: Key of the field used for bar heights and the tooltip value.
props.color: Bar fill color. Defaults to var(--accent). Use CSS custom properties for theme compatibility.
props.yLabel: Human-readable label shown in the tooltip instead of the raw yKey string.
props.formatY: Formats Y-axis tick labels. Receives a number, returns a string.
props.formatTooltip: Formats the value in the tooltip. Receives a number, returns a string.
props.height: Chart height in pixels. Defaults to 220.
